note: FULLY SYNTHETIC ground-truth identity clusters for the resolution-correctness scorer (Phase 74; expanded Phase 76 with deliberate merge AMBIGUITY for the merge-adjudication console). The `cluster` field is the LATENT TRUTH, kept ONLY in this evaluation-only channel — the resolver NEVER reads it (the resolver-input firewall, docs/true-entities-scorer-contract.md; the resolver sees ONLY obs_id/record_id/name/kind/role/identifiers). The `note` field is eval-only human gloss, stripped before the resolver. Ambiguity is seeded HONESTLY — it mirrors real-world structure (households share a landline, joint accounts share a number, coworkers share an inbox, the same person fragments across records, neighbours share a building address). The deliberate point: a shared identifier (or a shared name) does NOT by itself decide same-vs-distinct, so the deterministic resolver necessarily errs and the human merge gate is the control that adjudicates. Illustrative; production has no ground truth. Emails on .test, phones in the 555-01XX reserved range.
